notes: This narrow trace covers only the IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.3.1 parent-class subscription rule for a FOM-added HLAreport subclass. The test sends one subclass interaction and checks that the public callback reports the subscribed parent class, preserves all inherited parameters, and omits the subclass-only parameter. It does not claim complete MOM extension or conformance coverage.

requirements.source_symbol: Parent subscription class promotion and extension parameter loss
requirements.statement: If joined federates subscribe to the class of which an extension is a subclass, the interaction shall be promoted to the subscribed class and any new parameters shall be lost.
